tesourosPortal.name: Tesouros Portal
tesourosPortal.description: Adventure Club of Jaú managed everything on paper. Offline-first PWA with gamification (XP, levels), Supabase + PostgreSQL. RBAC, Playwright tests, LGPD compliance.

estacioPrep.name: Estacio Prep
estacioPrep.description: Gamified app with Duolingo-style XP, streaks, quizzes and analytics. Spaced repetition algorithm, 100% test coverage, CI/CD under 2 min per PR.

ignitecall.name: IgniteCall
ignitecall.description: Scheduling app with Google Calendar OAuth, custom Design System, automated CI/CD. Prisma ORM + Vercel deploys.

devStore.name: DevStore
devStore.description: SSR e-commerce with Stripe payments, smart caching, responsive design. SSR with ISR + 40% load time reduction.

forum.name: Forum DDD
forum.description: Full-stack forum built with Domain-Driven Design and Clean Architecture from scratch. Fastify + Prisma + unit and integration tests + turborepo monorepo.

hiremeAgent.name: HireMe Agent
hiremeAgent.description: AI-powered job search engine with resume analysis, automated sending via IMAP + Nodemailer, CLI with WebSocket. Hermes Agent (NousResearch) contributor.

testQubit.name: TestQubit
testQubit.description: AI-powered test generation CLI with multi-language adapters (TypeScript, Python, Java, C#, Ruby, Rust, Go). SaaS landing page with Stripe pricing, MCP server, and CI/CD integration.

hermesAgent.name: Hermes Agent
hermesAgent.description: Active contributor to NousResearch Hermes Agent: submitted PRs for the skills system (25+ bundled skills), delegate_tool with model/provider override, quota/rate-limit status bar, builtin tools and software-engineering excellence skills.

pianoLouvorja.name: Piano LouvorJA
pianoLouvorja.description: 71 merged PRs in the pianolouvorja org: cross-platform Electron desktop app (multi-screen, WebSocket/mDNS/Cast), Web PWA (live at app.pianolouvorja.com.br), native Android/iOS APK and the pianolouvorja.com.br site. Security hardening, multi-platform CI/CD releases, and bootstrap of Palco Receiver — smart TV integration (private org repo).

louvorja.name: LouvorJA
louvorja.description: 34 merged PRs in the LouvorJA ecosystem (louvorja org: API, App and Desktop). Developing the hymns API with multi-language catalog (PT/EN/ES), full audio via json_db + sda-hymnal + MIDI, plus contributions to the App and Desktop.

openHive.name: OpenHive
openHive.description: 4 merged PRs in OpenHive AI: multi-platform publishing UI, social account CRUD, OAuth flows, and MCP tool integrations.

rocketseatForumHelper.name: Rocketseat Forum Helper
rocketseatForumHelper.description: Chrome Extension MV3 helping Rocketseat students with intelligent forum responses. Published on Chrome Web Store, TypeScript, CI/CD, E2E with Playwright.

jornadaDeserto.name: Journey Through the Desert
jornadaDeserto.description: 3D biblical board game with Three.js/R3F. Interactive dice, 56 thematic cards, day/night cycle, milestones, gamepad support, and AI bots. Next.js 16, 565 tests, static build.

louvorjaMobile.name: LouvorJA Mobile
louvorjaMobile.description: Flutter mobile app for LouvorJA: hymns and Bible with real offline catalog, instant global search, persisted download queue with circuit breaker, PT/EN/ES i18n, WCAG AA and Play Store/iOS CI artifacts. 31 merged PRs.

omniroute.name: OmniRoute
omniroute.description: 18 merged PRs to OmniRoute: OpenAI-compatible LLM proxy with multi-provider routing, model fallback and performance optimizations.

about.title: About Me
about.bio:
From Jaú, Brazil. Started coding in 2024 and within 2 years contributed 100+ PRs to open source projects, built an AI-powered job search engine, and digitized a community club with gamification.

What sets me apart: I don't just take courses — I ship code to production. My projects have CI/CD, automated tests, and proper documentation.

Core stack: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Fastify, Supabase.
Focus: Clean Architecture, DDD, rigorous testing.
